title: Supplier Rebate and Price Support Claims
summary: For distributors: work out every volume rebate, price-drop compensation and special-price claim your principals owe, claim it with proof, and match what comes back.

seo.title: Supplier Rebate Claims for Distributors | VipraTech
seo.description: Calculate volume rebates, price-drop compensation and special-price claims owed by principals from purchases and resales, and reconcile their credit notes.

designed_for: CFO or Finance Controller at a distributor

problem.intro: Chemical, industrial and agri-input distributors buy under agreements that pay rebates for volume, compensate for price drops on stock in hand, and support special prices given to named customers. Each agreement has its own thresholds, periods and proof. The distributor has to work out what it is owed from its own purchases and resales, claim it on time and check what the principal pays.

pain_points.title: Rebates nobody calculates
pain_points.detail: Volume and growth rebates depend on purchases across a year by product family, and thresholds crossed late in the year are missed.

pain_points.title: Price drops on stock in hand
pain_points.detail: When a principal cuts its price, compensation on stock already held is claimed late or not at all.

pain_points.title: Special-price claims without proof
pain_points.detail: Claims for the gap between the normal price and a special price agreed for a customer need resale invoices that are hard to pull together.

pain_points.title: Payments that do not match claims
pain_points.detail: Principals pay rebates net, late or in lump sums, and the difference is never chased.

solution.overview: VipraTech reads each supplier agreement into rules: rebate slabs by product family and period, price protection terms, and special prices with their customers and validity. It calculates what you have earned from your purchase and resale data, prepares each claim with the invoices that prove it, and matches the principal's credit notes and statements to your claims. Rebates still to be earned show progress against the next threshold, so purchasing can act before the period ends.
capabilities: Supplier agreements set up as rules for rebates, price protection and special prices
Rebates earned calculated from purchases by product family and period
Price-drop compensation on stock held on the effective date
Special-price claims built from resale invoices to the named customer
Principal credit notes matched to claims, with shortfalls listed
Progress to the next rebate threshold for purchasing

match_rules.logic: Rebates are calculated on purchase invoices dated in the period, by product family, net of returns to the principal.
The rebate rate comes from the slab reached, using the agreement version for that period.

match_rules.rule: Stock held on the price-drop date
match_rules.logic: Price-drop compensation is calculated on stock held on the effective date, from purchases and resales up to that date.
Each special-price claim needs a resale invoice to the named customer, for listed products, within the validity and quantity agreed.
Each credit note must match a claim by period and amount. Shortfalls stay open with the principal's reason.

exception_codes.meaning: Purchases are below the slab for the period.
exception_codes.action: Show the gap to purchasing while there is time.

exception_codes.meaning: A special-price claim has no matching resale invoice.
exception_codes.action: Attach the invoice or drop the line.

exception_codes.meaning: Stock on the price-drop date cannot be confirmed from records.
exception_codes.action: Attach a stock statement for review.

exception_codes.meaning: The principal paid less than the claim.
exception_codes.action: Ask for the breakdown and follow up.

exception_codes.meaning: The claim is past the principal's submission window.

faqs.q: Our agreements are PDFs and emails. Can it use them?
faqs.a: Yes. Terms are read from the documents and confirmed by your team once, then kept as versioned rules.

faqs.q: Does it handle rebates by product family and growth?
faqs.a: Yes. Slabs can be set on volume, value or growth over last year, by product family and period.

faqs.q: Can it help with price drops on stock we hold?
faqs.a: Yes. It calculates stock held on the effective date from your purchases and resales, and prepares the compensation claim.

faqs.q: How is this different from claim recovery?
faqs.a: Claim recovery tracks claims you have already raised. This workflow works out what you are owed under each agreement in the first place.
